minor.issue: test_rebooking_message.py used r.json()['token'] but /auth/login returns access_token; and /onboarding payload was missing business_type/owner_name (now required). Fixed in-place.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() and window.alert() are inside the SAME try{}catch{}. If clipboard.writeText rejects (headless browsers; iOS Safari in insecure context; browsers where the write permission is denied), the alert line is skipped and the user sees NOTHING — the feature silently appears broken. Order should be alert first then clipboard, OR the clipboard call must be in its own inner try/catch. Reproduced in Playwright headless Chromium (first run alerts count = 0 despite API 200); after monkey-patching clipboard.writeText to resolve, alerts fire correctly.

action_items: (medium) In app/booking/[id].tsx (generateRebooking) and app/pet/[id].tsx (generateMessage), split the clipboard write into its own try/catch (or call alert before the clipboard write). Current structure makes the whole 'Rebooking message' feature invisible if the clipboard write fails for any reason — users would re-tap the button thinking it is broken, which is the exact class of bug this iteration was created to fix for the pay/rebook buttons.
(low) Consider logging failures from the outer try/catch in generateRebooking/generateMessage so silent failures surface in the console.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/booking/[id].tsx:88-101 and frontend/app/pet/[id].tsx:34-51 — swallowing all errors with `catch {}` and bundling clipboard+alert in one try block is risky; a transient clipboard rejection makes the user-visible feedback vanish.
The flex:1 wrapper + fullWidth fix on the pay-row and the pet Message button is correct and verified — right-edge taps at (x+width-8) land cleanly on both buttons and trigger the intended handlers.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG (right-edge taps on Pay in full / Generate rebooking message missed): FIX APPLIED by main agent (flex:1 View wrappers + fullWidth on Button) is VERIFIED working — right-edge clicks at x+width-8 land inside the Pressable's hit area for both pay-row buttons and the rebooking button. SECONDARY BUG surfaced during testing: generateRebooking/generateMessage swallow clipboard rejections together with window.alert because both live inside the same `try{...}catch{}`. In environments where navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects (Playwright headless default, iOS Safari without user gesture context, browsers served over http), the catch swallows the clipboard error and never reaches window.alert — the user sees nothing. MITIGATION: wrap the clipboard call in its own inner try/catch so the alert always fires on success, OR call window.alert BEFORE the clipboard write.
